markdown:
## The Ghosting Epidemic

Candidate ghosting — disappearing without communication during the hiring process — has reached epidemic levels. According to Indeed, 28% of candidates have ghosted an employer in the past year.

But before blaming candidates, consider: 77% of job seekers say they have been ghosted by an employer. The behavior flows both ways.

### Why Candidates Ghost

- Better offer accepted (38%): They moved on and felt awkward saying so
- Poor candidate experience (24%): Process was frustrating or disrespectful
- Too slow (19%): They lost interest waiting
- Accepted counter-offer (11%): Current employer retained them
- Life circumstances (8%): Personal reasons unrelated to the opportunity

### 7 Prevention Tactics

#### 1. Speed Up the Process

Every day of delay increases ghosting risk by 3%. Compress your timeline:

- Screen within 48 hours of application
- Schedule interviews within 24 hours of screen
- Complete all rounds within 10 days
- Offer within 24 hours of final interview

#### 2. Communicate Proactively

Do not wait for candidates to ask for updates:

- "You will hear from us by [specific date]"
- "Your interview is confirmed for [date]. Here is what to expect."
- "We are still in the decision process. We expect to have an update by [date]."

#### 3. Build Emotional Investment

Help candidates envision themselves in the role:

- Share the team's current projects and challenges
- Introduce them to future teammates
- Discuss their 90-day impact plan
- Show the physical or virtual workspace

#### 4. Remove Friction

Make every interaction easy:

- Self-scheduling for interviews
- Clear instructions for assessments
- Video interviews with simple technology
- Mobile-friendly application

#### 5. Create an Off-Ramp

Make it easy to decline gracefully:

- "If your situation has changed, there is absolutely no hard feelings. A quick reply helps us help other candidates."
- Remove the stigma of saying no

#### 6. Multi-Channel Communication

Do not rely on email alone:

- Text message confirmations
- Calendar invitations with video links
- Phone calls for important updates
- LinkedIn for informal touchpoints

#### 7. Use Pre-Scored Candidates

Candidates who have been pre-screened and are confirmed interested have much lower ghosting rates. Our subscription model delivers candidates who have been screened, scored, and confirmed before they reach your pipeline.

### When Ghosting Happens Anyway

Accept that some ghosting is inevitable. Mitigate impact:

- Maintain a backup pipeline (never rely on a single candidate)
- Track ghosting patterns by stage, source, and role type
- Use data to identify process improvements
- Keep the door open for future engagement

Build a reliable pipeline that reduces your exposure to candidate ghosting.
